description: Audit-Driven Development registry. Rules are the living spec.

rules.description: 実行前後に git status を確認する
ArchiMate language profile and migration tests pass
C260 book-derived section, aggregate, outline, and source-runlog coverage audit passes
Appendix C example viewpoint headings remain exposed as an informative catalog without bundling normative viewpoint definitions
rules.command: node --test --test-name-pattern "Appendix C example viewpoints as an informative catalog" test/language-profile.test.mjs

rules.description: Appendix C informative viewpoint catalog is exposed through implementation status and the completion scan
ArchiMate 4 host-facing conformance report preserves official blockers, missing required sources, required-before-claim actions, and companion gaps from the implementation status
Viewer and Editor demos render the flattened ArchiMate 4 conformance report while keeping ArchiMate 3.x marked as not applicable
Current W262 and MEFF 4.0 XSD source evidence stays aligned with archimate4-profile sourceCoverage and the host-facing conformance report
rules.command: node --test --test-name-pattern "source coverage|external source|MEFF 4 XSD|3.1 XSD evidence|conformance report" test/language-profile.test.mjs

rules.description: ArchiMate model validation diagnostics cover profile mismatch, retired concepts, relationship rules, multiplicity, junction consistency, view viewpoint references, view node element references and geometry, view connection relationship references, endpoint references, endpoint-to-relationship alignment, waypoint geometry, view style/font/color values including invalid font.style plain combinations, model-defined and profile-defined viewpoint allowed-type application to View contents, viewpoint stakeholder/concern and modeling-note structure, BaseObject name/documentation string fields, organization identifier references, property definition structure and references, present property value string structure, viewpoint definitions, and profile attribute property values
ESLint passes for ArchiMate 4 implementation files
